For the Talarico, El-Sayed and Ossoff transcripts, each paragraph was matched to the video by its opening words, and paragraphs that did not match carry no timestamp. Seventeen quotes and claims about the main 18 speeches were compared with the transcripts: 7 matched word for word, 4 differed slightly and now use the words spoken, and 6 were not in the video. The Constitution leaves most day-to-day governing to states and localities: policing, schools, zoning, elections, water.
